label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
output:
Here's a draft you can copy and send. At the bottom there are two small notes.

---

**Subject: I'm safe, and thank you (please read before sending me anything)**

Hi everyone,

If you're getting this, you're a friend, a neighbour, one of my Little Acorns families, or someone who got this forwarded to you. Thank you for caring enough to read it. I'm Thandi. I teach the Ladybirds (Grade 00) at Little Acorns Pre-Primary in Mowbray, and I lived at Lindale Court on Station Road in Observatory.

My phone has not stopped since Saturday night, and I'm so tired that I can't answer everyone one by one. So I'm writing it all down once, properly, and you can pass it on to anyone who's asking.

**First: I'm okay.**
I'm physically fine and staying with my sister in Rondebosch. Marmalade is fine too. She hid under the car for two hours afterwards and was thoroughly offended by the whole thing, but she's eating and sulking normally.

**What happened (the short version)**
A fire started around 11:40pm on Saturday 7 November in a ground floor flat at Lindale Court. It wasn't mine. I'm on the second floor, flat 12. All 14 flats got out. Two people were treated for smoke inhalation at Groote Schuur and sent home the same night, which I'm so grateful for.

The fire department thinks it was probably an electrical fault, but they're still investigating, so I'm not going to guess and I'd ask you not to either.

I woke up because my neighbour, Uncle Faizel, banged on every single door on our floor in his vest and slippers. I honestly don't know what would have happened without him. I grabbed my phone and Marmalade and ran. That's all I took, and I wouldn't change it. Furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can't.

My flat is mostly smoke and water damage, and the ceiling came down in the lounge. The landlord says nobody can move back in for at least six weeks. I'd rather not go through all of it again, so please forgive me if I don't want to talk through the details.

**What I actually need**
I'm really not good at asking for help, so I'm going to be specific so nobody has to guess.

- **Help with the deposit on a new place.** This is the big one. Having to find somewhere new while paying for everything again is the scary part.
- **Shoes for school (size 6) and work clothes (size 34).** I have essentially what I'm standing in.
- **A laptop, if anyone has an old one lying around that still works.** All my lesson planning was on mine, and it's gone.

**What I don't need**
Please don't take this the wrong way, because I'm so touched that people want to help. But right now:

- **No more clothes in general.** I already have more than I can use. Anything extra that comes in, I'll pass on to the other families from the building who lost things too.
- **No food.** My sister's freezer is completely full, and I'm being fed like a queen.

If you really want to do something and none of the above fits, a kind message is more than enough. I've cried at every single one.

**The fundraiser (the real one)**
My friend Zinhle set up a BackaBuddy page for me. I'll be honest, I feel really weird about it. I hate asking for things. Zinhle told me to shut up and accept it, so I'm accepting it, and I'm trying to do that gracefully. The target is R25 000, and as of this morning it's at R11 400, which I still can't believe.

This is the only fundraiser that's mine:

**backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court**

**Please read this part carefully: there is a fake one going around.**
Some people have been sending me a "Thandi Fire Relief" page on another website, and there's also a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money to a Capitec account. **That is not me. I have nothing to do with it.** I've already reported it.

So please:

- Only use the BackaBuddy link above.
- Do not send money to any bank account that someone WhatsApps you, even if it has my name on it.
- If you're ever unsure whether something is real, ask Zinhle or ask me before you pay anything.
- If you see the fake page or message being shared, please tell the person who sent it that it's not legitimate. It's sad that people do this, but I'd hate for anyone who's trying to be kind to lose their money.

**To the Little Acorns families**
Thank you. I mean it. One of my moms dropped off a bag of clothes at my sister's gate at 7am on Sunday and didn't even knock. I don't know who it was exactly, and I'm saying thank you here in case you read this: it was so thoughtful, and I was in tears at the gate.

A few things so you know what's happening:

- **The end of year concert on 27 November is still on.** Please don't worry about it. The Ladybirds will have their crowns. I'd taken the 22 crowns home to laminate, and they went in the fire along with the kids' handprint banner. We'll remake them. It might be a bit of a glue-and-glitter situation, but it'll happen.
- **I'm back at school on Wednesday.** Please don't make a big thing of it in front of the kids. They're four and five, and I want things to feel as normal and happy as possible for them. A quiet hug from you is perfect, and I'll take it gladly. Just not a big welcome in front of the class.

**One more request**
I'm going to reply to comments slowly, and I may not get to DMs at all for a while. Please don't be offended if I take days or if I miss yours. It has nothing to do with how much your message means to me. I read every one. I'm just running on very little right now.

I'm going to be okay. I have a sister who has taken me in, a friend who won't let me say no, a neighbour who saved my life in his slippers, and more kind people around me than I knew about. I'll keep everyone updated when I have news, and once I'm settled somewhere, I'm going to say proper thank-yous to everyone.

With so much love and gratitude,

Thandi

---

Two small notes:

1. **Wednesday:** Today is Wednesday 11 November. If you're sending this today, or if "Wednesday" will land on a different week by the time people read it, change that line to the specific date (for example, "Wednesday 18 November") so it doesn't get confusing when it's forwarded.
2. **Fundraiser total:** The R11 400 will be out of date quickly. You might want to change it to "over R11 000" or take the number out, so the letter still reads right as it goes around.

I can also do a much shorter version of this for WhatsApp, with just the safe-update, the real link, and the scam warning, if you'd like something people can forward without scrolling.
